#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/lhl/hipEngine
PY=/home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python3.12
ROOT=$("$PY" -m rocm_sdk path --root)
LOG=/tmp/hipengine-paro-refresh-20261023
mkdir -p "$LOG"
"$ROOT/bin/hipcc" --version > "$LOG/hipcc-version.txt"
ENV=(env -i HOME="$HOME" USER="${USER:-$(id -un)}" LOGNAME="${LOGNAME:-${USER:-$(id -un)}}" SHELL="${SHELL:-/bin/bash}" TERM="${TERM:-xterm}" PATH="$ROOT/bin:/home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROOT/lib:/home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/lib/python3.12/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_core/lib:/home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/lib/python3.12/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_libraries_gfx110X_all/lib" HIP_PATH="$ROOT" ROCM_PATH="$ROOT" HIP_LIB_PATH="$ROOT/lib" HIP_INCLUDE_PATH="$ROOT/include" HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE="$LOG/hipcc-version.txt" PYTHONPATH="$PWD")
MODEL=/home/lhl/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--shisa-ai--Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-PARO-packed/snapshots/437eba06df05aad71a4dacdcaf3fff70ae1ee8a1
BASE=(scripts/qwen35_readme_sweep.py --engine paro --model "$MODEL" --backend hip_gfx1100 --shared-expert-format packed_paro_w4 --token-id 9707 --compiler-version-file "$LOG/hipcc-version.txt" --attn-aotriton-min-tokens 512 --graph-replay-decode)
git status -sb > "$LOG/git-status.txt"
"${ENV[@]}" "$PY" -c 'import ctypes; h=ctypes.CDLL("libamdhip64.so"); v=ctypes.c_int(); h.hipRuntimeGetVersion(ctypes.byref(v)); print("HIP runtime", v.value)' | tee "$LOG/runtime.txt"
echo '[prebuild] PARO 512/1'
"${ENV[@]}" timeout 900 "$PY" "${BASE[@]}" --workloads 512/1 --warmup-runs 0 --measured-runs 1 --warmup-decode-tokens 4 --json "$LOG/prebuild.json" > "$LOG/prebuild.log" 2>&1
components=()
for workload in 512/128 1K/128 4K/128 32K/128 64K/128 128K/128; do
  safe=${workload//\//-}
  echo "[measure] PARO $workload"
  "${ENV[@]}" timeout 2400 "$PY" "${BASE[@]}" --workloads "$workload" --warmup-runs 2 --measured-runs 5 --warmup-decode-tokens 4 --require-cached-build --json "$LOG/paro-$safe.json" > "$LOG/paro-$safe.log" 2>&1
  components+=("$LOG/paro-$safe.json")
done
echo '[merge] PARO six-shape sweep'
"${ENV[@]}" "$PY" scripts/merge_readme_sweep_components.py --platform gfx1100 --engine paro --components "${components[@]}" --json "$LOG/paro-sweep.json" > "$LOG/merge.log" 2>&1
echo '[complete] PARO six-shape sweep'
